candidates.author: Maria Alvarez
candidates.quote: We used Party On Delivery for my sister's bachelorette on Lake Travis and it was perfect. I was so worried about how much to buy and they walked me through everything. The boat was stocked before we even got to the marina!!
candidates.excerpt: I was so worried about how much to buy and they walked me through everything.

candidates.author: Sam Oakley
candidates.quote: Booked them again, this time for a corporate happy hour at the office. Seamless as always and the delivery was right on time even though we ordered last minute.
candidates.excerpt: Seamless as always and the delivery was right on time even though we ordered last minute.

candidates.author: Maria Alvarez
candidates.quote: Second time using them, this time for a birthday boat day. Still flawless. They even remembered our order from last time and had suggestions ready. Truly did not have to think about a single thing all weekend, which as the planner friend is priceless.
candidates.excerpt: Truly did not have to think about a single thing all weekend, which as the planner friend is priceless.

candidates.author: Paragraph Pete
candidates.quote:
They delivered a keg, a tap, a barrel and ice for our block party.

Instead of driving to three stores and borrowing a truck, I made one call.	Having it all show up took a huge part of the planning off my plate.
candidates.excerpt: They delivered a keg, a tap, a barrel and ice for our block party.
